description:
Go inside Duluth Dylan Fest's Singer-Songwriter contest 
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Duluth, Minnesota, is the birthplace of Bob Dylan — and the city knows how to celebrate the man born Robert Zimmerman in Duluth on May 24, 1941, with the annual Duluth Dylan Fest. One of Duluth Dylan Fest's signature events is a singer-songwriter contest where participants play a Dylan cover followed by an original song.

Here is an inside look at Duluth Dylan Fest's singer-songwriter contest, which took place this year on May 22 at Sacred Heart Music Center in Duluth. 

Listen to The Current on Sunday, May 31, 2026, from 6 a.m. to noon CDT as host Bill DeVille shares the 85 Essential Bob Dylan Songs — as voted by you. Follow along here: https://www.thecurrent.org/song-countdown/85-essential-bob-dylan-songs
